narrative.synopsis: Hephaestus answers rejection with craft rather than open war. His golden throne traps Hera until Dionysus brings the estranged smith back to Olympus, where release and recognition become linked.
narrative.openingSituation: Hephaestus has been excluded from the divine household that still needs his craft.
narrative.centralConflict: Hera is trapped by a gift only Hephaestus can undo.
narrative.resolution: Dionysus returns with Hephaestus, and the smith releases Hera.
narrative.outcome: Hephaestus’ craft gains power and his place among the gods is restored.
